title_en: Information Session on Study and Scholarships in Germany (DAAD & Humboldt)
summary: The Office of International Affairs will hold an information session on study in Germany, exchange programs and scholarships for research in Germany (DAAD & Humboldt). Interested students and researchers may attend on Monday, 21 September 2026, from 17:30 to 18:30, in the 1st-floor Seminar Room of the Office of International Affairs (Building 152). applies_to: Optional, not mandatory. Open to all undergraduate students, graduate students and researchers interested in study, exchange or research funding in Germany. translation:
Information Session on Study in Germany and Scholarships (DAAD & Humboldt)

The Office of International Affairs will hold an information session on study in Germany, exchange student programs and scholarships. Interested students are asked to take note.

1. Event: Scholarships for Study and Research in Germany (DAAD & Humboldt)

2. Date, time and place: Monday, 21 September 2026, 17:30–18:30 (1 hour) | 1st-floor Seminar Room, Office of International Affairs (Building 152)

3. Who may attend: all undergraduate students, graduate students and researchers interested in study, exchange or research funding in Germany

4. Programme

17:30–17:40 | Welcome remarks | An officer of the Office of International Affairs; a professor of the Department of German Language and Literature; the Director of DAAD Seoul

17:40–18:30 | Introduction to DAAD (German Academic Exchange Service) scholarships: Summer Course for undergraduates; scholarships for master's and doctoral programs | A representative (Dr.) of the DAAD Seoul Office

18:30– | Questions, answers and networking | Exchange students and researchers from Germany, among others

(Names of individual speakers are given in the original notice and are omitted here.)

※ This event is intended for foreign exchange or visiting students currently here from Germany, students who have already taken part in an exchange program at a German university, students currently preparing to be sent on an exchange semester in Germany, and students interested in Germany.

Attachments (2):
Attachment 1. Promotional poster (PDF, 2 MB)
Attachment 2. Event details (DOCX, 16 KB)
(The content of these attachments was not read for this translation.)
